title: Boss: the notification hub
summary: Combine Strategy, Factory, Decorator and Observer into a small notification system.

steps.title: The hub
body: You are building notifications. Messages go out over a **channel** chosen by name (Strategy + Factory), channels can be **wrapped** with extra behaviour (Decorator), and the hub **announces** every delivery (Observer).
Every step gives you the code from the previous one.

steps.title: Channels and a factory
prompt: - `interface IChannel { string Send(string to, string text); }`
- `class EmailChannel` returning `email to <to>: <text>` and `class SmsChannel` returning `sms to <to>: <text>` (SMS truncates `text` to 10 characters)
- `static class Channels` with `static IChannel Create(string name)` for `email` and `sms`, throwing `ArgumentException` otherwise
solution: interface IChannel { string Send(string to, string text); }
public string Send(string to, string text) => $"email to {to}: {text}";
public string Send(string to, string text) =>
public static IChannel Create(string name) => name switch
template: Dojo.Eq("email", "email to ada: Hello there", Channels.Create("email").Send("ada", "Hello there"));
Dojo.Eq("sms truncates", "sms to 555: Hello ther", Channels.Create("sms").Send("555", "Hello there"));

steps.title: Decorate the channel
prompt: Add two decorators, without changing the channels:
- `class PrefixChannel(IChannel inner, string prefix) : IChannel` puts `prefix` in front of the text before passing it on
- `class AuditChannel(IChannel inner) : IChannel` stores every result string it returns in `public List<string> Log { get; } = new();`
starter: interface IChannel { string Send(string to, string text); }
class EmailChannel : IChannel { public string Send(string to, string text) => $"email to {to}: {text}"; }
solution: interface IChannel { string Send(string to, string text); }
class EmailChannel : IChannel { public string Send(string to, string text) => $"email to {to}: {text}"; }
class PrefixChannel(IChannel inner, string prefix) : IChannel
public string Send(string to, string text) => inner.Send(to, prefix + text);
public string Send(string to, string text)
template: var dojoAudit = new AuditChannel(new PrefixChannel(new EmailChannel(), "[urgent] "));
Dojo.Eq("prefixed", "email to ada: [urgent] Server down", dojoAudit.Send("ada", "Server down"));
Dojo.Eq("audit log", new List<string> { "email to ada: [urgent] Server down", "email to bob: [urgent] Fixed" }, dojoAudit.Log);

steps.title: Announce deliveries
prompt: - `public void Notify(IEnumerable<string> recipients, string text)` that sends to each recipient through `channel` and raises `Delivered` with each result
The hub does not know who listens. The tests subscribe a counter and a list.
starter: interface IChannel { string Send(string to, string text); }
class EmailChannel : IChannel { public string Send(string to, string text) => $"email to {to}: {text}"; }
solution: interface IChannel { string Send(string to, string text); }
class EmailChannel : IChannel { public string Send(string to, string text) => $"email to {to}: {text}"; }
public void Notify(IEnumerable<string> recipients, string text)
template: Dojo.Eq("every delivery announced", new List<string> { "email to ada: Lunch?", "email to bob: Lunch?" }, dojoSeen);
Dojo.Eq("no listeners is fine", "", Dojo.Capture(() => new Hub(new EmailChannel()).Notify(new[] { "x" }, "y")));
